name: fb-api-monorepo
description: Monorepo quản lý Facebook Page phân tán

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix webhook-service && npm install --prefix core-service && npm install --prefix backend-api && npm install --prefix retry-service
scripts.setup:fresh: npm run install:all && npm run demo:env
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -c "blue,green,yellow,red" -n "WEBHOOK,CORE,BACKEND,RETRY" "npm run dev --prefix webhook-service" "npm run dev --prefix core-service" "npm run dev --prefix backend-api" "npm run dev --prefix retry-service"
scripts.demo:bai2: concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -c "blue,green" -n "WEBHOOK,CORE" "npm run dev --prefix webhook-service" "npm run dev --prefix core-service"
scripts.demo:bai3: concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -c "blue,green,yellow,red" -n "WEBHOOK,CORE,BACKEND,RETRY" "npm run dev --prefix webhook-service" "npm run dev --prefix core-service" "npm run dev --prefix backend-api" "npm run dev --prefix retry-service"
scripts.stop: echo "Để dừng tất cả các dịch vụ, hãy nhấn Ctrl+C trong terminal đang chạy npm run dev."
